source.lineage: immutable SW0097 seed1 checkpoint mapped by frozen SW0135 native32 foundation
source.images: first64 ordered registered source1 TRAIN IDs only
source.rgb: registered clean uint8 NHWC [B,128,128,3] TRAIN cache

rollout.q: unchanged SW0145._actual_q from the same native emitted-spike trace; exact equality required at kappa=0
rollout.rng: snapshot CPU and selected CUDA RNG before native rollout and restore before adaptive rollout

event_history.zero_gate: emitted spike is zero; auxiliary event/history recurrent states hold
event_history.truncation: live recurrence; detach auxiliary state only at registered TBPTT boundary

calibration.scale: per-component float64 RMS of settled native membrane minus existing source threshold over exactly first64 source TRAIN images
calibration.parity_execution: kappa=0 makes scale inactive; use a fixed positive unit scale for the paired exact-parity call and reuse the same native rollout traces for scale calculation
calibration.failure: reject nonfinite or nonpositive component scale; no event-rate tuning

outputs.reports: create-once compact JSON; no predictions, labels, checkpoints, masks, or training artifacts
diagnostics: settled event on/zero/one fractions by component
native/adaptive rollout timing and peak CUDA memory

limitations: This driver has not been executed on a GPU or trained source checkpoint.
CPU synthetic-core parity does not establish parity on actual trained native32 weights.
The preflight is not training admission and makes no learning, causal, or segmentation claim.
